metadata.title: The Bulge Radial Velocity Assay for RR Lyrae stars (BRAVA-RR) DR2: a Bimodal Bulge?

notes: No eligible stars. The paper studies bulge RR Lyrae stars and identifies some high-space-velocity stars as likely halo interlopers, while defining halo stars by apocenter >3.5 kpc (T:p7-b5). It does not state that any individual star is unbound from the Milky Way, and a halo/interloper classification does not itself establish Galactic unbound candidacy. No star is presented as a prior Galactic unbound candidate being followed up.
